competitors.what_they_have: Likely #1 for the German backpacker cluster. H1 'Wie du in Australien deine Steuerrückerstattung beantragst', 3-point intro, 'Der richtige Zeitpunkt' section, DIY vs service section, 'Wichtige Unterlagen', super section, 15 reader comments. Weak: last changed Feb 2025, cites TaxPack, Payment Summary, 9 % super, an average refund figure and a % fee; no FAQ, no table, no current rates. Beat it on freshness, timing rules and verifiable figures.

Question-shaped H2s used as FAQ (wer ist berechtigt, wann abgeben, resident oder non-resident, was passiert ohne Erklärung, wie funktioniert die Rückerstattung), 4 numbered steps, affiliate CTA to Taxback. Updated Dec 2025 but states 32.5 %, a 30 June 'deadline' and averages. Gap for us: 'Was passiert, wenn ich keine Erklärung mache' and 'wann abgeben'.

First-person myGov walkthrough (8 steps, linking myGov to ATO is the hard part), tip to lodge from August once employers have reported, refund vs owing story. 2021/22, outdated 32.5 % rate. Its 'wait until employers have reported' advice is the one we lack, and we can state it with the ATO source.

TFN + tax return + rate tables in one page, bullet 'Hinweise zur Steuerrückerstattung im Überblick', links to ATO residency test and simple tax calculator. Tables are 2021/22 and contradictory (29 % vs 15 %). A dated key-figures block on our page beats it.

Ranks for 'Steuererklärung Australien Work and Travel': German-side question (Anlage N-AUS). Signals intent we do not answer at all; a one-line FAQ that routes it to the Finanzamt keeps the reader on our page without giving German tax advice.

facts.fact: WHM rates 15 % to 45,000, 30 % to 135,000, 37 % to 190,000, 45 % above; effective 1 July 2026, unchanged from 2025-26; no tax-free threshold
45 % withholding when no TFN is on file
Medicare levy 2 %; Germany, Austria, Switzerland not RHCA countries; exemption via Medicare Entitlement Statement
Deadline 31 October; 2025-26 was 31 October 2026 (passed), late return can still be lodged
Addy v Commissioner of Taxation [2021] HCA 34 may change rates for some WHMs, case by case
facts.source: public/llms.txt Key facts (High Court of Australia)

facts.fact: Employers finalise STP data by 14 July
ATO recommends waiting until income statement is 'Tax ready'; lodging early may require amending
'The best time to lodge is from late July once everything is ready' (updated 26 June 2025)
Early lodgment only if leaving permanently before 30 June and no further Australian-sourced income other than interest, dividends, royalties; paper return only; 50 business days processing
Lodging online from overseas via myTax is possible; an Australian bank account is needed to receive a refund
'Most returns lodged online process within 10 business days'
Failure to lodge on time penalty generally not issued for a late return resulting in a refund or nil (exceptions apply); updated 22 June 2026
